patch_description: Structural redesign: replace the annealed-softmin L-BFGS seed loop with a physics-style sphere-repulsion engine. Points are placed on the unit sphere and relaxed under inverse-power repulsion with an annealed exponent (2→32), which naturally approximates a Tammes-type spread where the min-distance-to-diameter ratio is high (dmax is bounded by 2 on the sphere, so good Tammes-like spreads beat the reference ratio). The engine is pure vectorized numpy (fast, no per-seed scipy cost), runs many random seeds plus structured seeds (cube+octahedron, antipodal cube), and only the top candidates are polished with the existing analytic-gradient softmin L-BFGS stage, now wrapped with pre-validation (shape/finiteness guards) so a malformed candidate can never crash or zero out the run. Best configuration is selected by true score and normalized before return.
